title: EnableSprinting - InputEnableLayer
content:
Member of: InputEnableLayer Script Enables or disables the player's ability to sprint on this layer. Syntax: Function EnableSprinting(abEnable = true) native Parameters: - abEnable: If true, enables sprinting. Otherwise disables it. Default: True Return Value: None. Examples: ; Enable sprinting myLayer.EnableSprinting()
; Disable sprinting InputEnableLayer myLayer = InputEnableLayer.Create() myLayer.EnableSprinting(false) See Also: - InputEnableLayer Script - IsSprintingEnabled - InputEnableLayer
